description: Builds a Bambu project 3MF from a base body STL plus extra parts. A negative part (negative_part) cuts away where it overlaps, a modifier (modifier_part) applies different settings to its region, and support_blocker / support_enforcer control support. In a Bambu model each of these is just one more part with a label, so no geometry (boolean) engine is needed. The output can be read back item by item with bambu_inspect_project, or passed straight to bambu_slice. Writes a file to the output directory.

baseName.description: Display name of the base body part. Defaults to body.

basePath.description: Path to the base body STL; it must be inside an allowed model directory.

name.description: Output file name (.3mf is appended automatically) and object name. Must not contain path separators.

position.description: Centre of the primitive shape, in the same coordinate system as the base body. Ignored for stl shapes.

settings.description: Per-part settings; honoured only for modifier_part.

subtype.description: negative_part cuts material away, modifier_part is a region with local settings, support_blocker / support_enforcer control support, normal_part adds a solid. BambuStudio silently treats any unrecognised string as normal_part, so only these five are accepted.

plateCentre.description: Where the object lands on the plate. Defaults to the centre of a 256×256 plate (128, 128).

name: bambu_compose_model
title: Compose a 3MF with negative / modifier parts
